verdict.rationale: Docs describe container-tag scoping and explicit deletion workflows for user/tenant data ('when the user requests deletion, delete that container's content via the API/console'), document delete operations, and a self-hosted option for full data control; SOC2/HIPAA BAA also signal formal data governance. However, there's no documented retention policy (TTL/auto-expiry), no bulk/account-level 'delete everything' API, and no independent audit or hands-on confirmation that deletion actually purges data from graph/embeddings. missing for 10: documented retention/TTL settings, account-wide erasure API, independent verification that deleted data is fully purged from graph and embeddings.
